This tutorial covers the mathematics that theoretical physics relies on. It starts with sets and topology, moves through analysis,
differential equations and probability, and ends with differential geometry, Lie groups, fibre bundles and spinors.

Each chapter sets out definitions and results, works through examples, and gives exercises to try. It's the first of three connected
tutorials. [Fundamentals of Theoretical Physics](../fundamentals-of-theoretical-physics/index.qmd) builds on it, and both lead to
[Kaluza-Klein Theories](../kaluza-klein-theories/index.qmd).

- [Linear algebra](part-i-02-linear-algebra.qmd)
- [Real analysis](part-i-03-real-analysis.qmd)
- [Complex analysis](part-i-04-complex-analysis.qmd)
- [Differential equations](part-i-05-differential-equations.qmd)
- [Fourier analysis](part-i-06-fourier-analysis.qmd)
- [Functional analysis](part-i-07-hilbert-spaces-operators.qmd)
- [Probability and statistics](part-i-08-probability.qmd)
- [Differential geometry](part-i-09-differential-geometry.qmd)
- [Group theory](part-i-10-group-theory.qmd)
- [Lie groups and Lie algebras](part-i-11-lie-groups-algebras.qmd)
- [Homogeneous spaces and fibre bundles](part-i-12-homogeneous-spaces-bundles.qmd)
- [Spinors and the Dirac operator](part-i-13-spinors-dirac-operator.qmd)

This tutorial has its own [glossary](glossary.qmd) and [verification registry](registry.qmd). Works cited are listed at the end of each chapter.
